status_scope: Rows containing value as an evaluated scalar field occurrence; other atoms may separately be insufficient or normal. Parser rejection is accepted only where insufficient is expected.

probes.body: u32 n = 7; if (p->value == n) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: Explicit local host literal source compared directly to encoded field; only a portability candidate.

probes.body: u32 n = 7; if (n == p->value) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: Swapping the sides of equality preserves the representation mismatch.

probes.body: u32 n = 7; if (le32_to_cpu(p->value) == n) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: Exact width and direction decoding of this field occurrence.

probes.body: u32 n = cpu_to_le32(7); if (p->value == n) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: u32 is a C carrier; explicit initializer carries encoded-LE32 representation.

probes.body: u32 n = cpu_to_le32(7); if (p->value < n) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: Same encoded representation does not preserve numeric ordering on a different endian host.

probes.body: if (p->value == 0) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: Zero equality is representation invariant for the supported scalar field.

probes.body: if (p->value > 0) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: Protocol conservatively excludes ordered zero comparisons.

probes.body: u32 n = 7; if (le64_to_cpu(p->value) == n) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: A conversion bearing the wrong field width cannot certify this read.

probes.body: u32 n = 7; if (be32_to_cpu(p->value) == n) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: BE32 decoding does not certify an LE32 field.

probes.body: if (p->value == parameter) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: A u32 parameter's declaration alone gives no caller representation source.

probes.body: u32 n = helper(); if (p->value == n) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: Unknown function result must not become host merely from u32 storage.

probes.body: u32 n = 7; mutate(&n); if (p->value == n) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: Address escape permits unmodeled updates to the apparent host value.

probes.body: u32 n = 7; { u32 n = 8; if (p->value == n) return 1; } return 0;
probes.basis: The limited rule must not choose a last or first same-name declaration.

probes.body: u32 n; if (parameter) n = 7; if (p->value == n) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: Only conditional initialization does not establish a definite local source.

probes.body: u32 n = 7; if (le32_to_cpu(p->value) == n) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: A locally redefined helper spelling is not conversion evidence.

probes.body: u32 n = 7; if ((parameter && (p->value == n || le32_to_cpu(p->other) == n))) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: Depth-aware logical atoms; the other atom's matching conversion must not normalize value.

probes.body: u32 n = 7; if (p->value == n + le32_to_cpu(p->value)) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: Complex repeated use of the target inside one atom exceeds the supported grammar.

probes.body: u32 n = 7; if (p->value[0] == n) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: Array members are outside direct scalar field binding.

probes.body: if (p->value & cpu_to_le32(7)) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: The complete mask operand has the matching encoded representation.

probes.body: if (p->value & (cpu_to_le32(1) | MASK_UNKNOWN)) return 1; return 0;
probes.basis: One converted suboperand cannot certify the unknown whole mask.

limitations: These are development boundary probes and never independent defect examples.
Expected normal means only the protocol's supported local shape, never runtime correctness.
No code execution, source querying, or root implementation inspection happened while writing this specification.
